desc: The True Precision SIG P365 FUSE Threaded Barrel is a high-performance upgrade designed for enhanced accuracy and durability. Precision-machined from high-quality stainless steel, this drop-in barrel features a threaded muzzle (1/2x28) for compatibility with suppressors and compensators. Its advanced broach-cut rifling ensures improved shot consistency, while the unique FUSE coating provides superior wear and corrosion resistance. Ideal for competitive shooters and everyday carry, this barrel delivers a refined balance of function and style.
